title: FY27 Holland & St. Joseph Harbors Maintenance Dredging (MD)
description: THIS IS A PRE-SOLICITATION NOTICE. THIS IS NOT A REQUEST FOR PROPOSAL OR INVITATION FOR BID. The US Army Corps of Engineers (USACE) Detroit District is seeking contractors with the capability to provide maintenance dredging at the Holland and St. Joseph Harbors. Scope of Work: Mobilize dredge to both Holland Harbor and St. Joseph Harbor, perform dredging operations and place the dredged material at the placement sites according to the plans and demobilize when dredging is complete. Mobilize to Holland Harbor and St. Joseph Harbor and dredge between the limits as shown on the contract drawings. Place dredged material at respective placement sites pertaining to each harbor, as outlined in the contract drawings and specifications. If applicable option(s) are exercised, re-mobilize to Holland Harbor and St. Joseph Harbor in 2028 and 2029 and dredge between the limits as shown on the contract drawings. Upon completion of the work, clean-up and demobilize from the harbors. The North American Industrial Classification System (NAICS) code for this work is 237990, Other Heavy and Civil Engineering Construction, which has a small business size standard of $37.0 million in average annual receipts with the Dredging and Surface Cleanup Activities exception. The Government intends to solicit this opportunity as an Invitation for Bid (IFB) and intends to issue the IFB as a 100% set-aside for small businesses. The Government intends to award to the contractor who submits the lowest priced bid that is determined to be responsible and responsive. General Information: The Government intends to issue a Firm-Fixed Price (FFP) Construction Contract. Anticipated Solicitation Posting Date: Fall/Winter 2026 Anticipated Proposal Due Date: Winter/Spring 2027 The solicitation package materials, documents, drawings, specifications, and attachments to the anticipated solicitation will be available only electronically. The Notice of the solicitation will be posted on the System for Award Management (SAM). Contractors can access SAM free of charge at www.sam.gov. The solicitation Notice posted on SAM.gov will include a link to all solicitation documents which will be stored in the Solicitation Module of the Procurement Integrated Enterprise Environment (PIEE) system. Contractors may register for PIEE free of charge at https://piee.eb.mil/. In order for interested contractors to conduct business with the Federal Government, contractors must be registered in PIEE prior to the proposal due date and in SAM.gov prior to any award. Hard copy documents will NOT be supplied by the Government to any interested parties as a result of this Pre-Solicitation Notice or the upcoming solicitation. Electronic proposal submissions will be required through the PIEE Solicitation Module suite at https://piee.eb.mil/. Please note the Government will not be maintaining a bidders list during the solicitation period. However, vendors are strongly encouraged to review the "Interested Vendors List" found on sam.gov for this requirement.

title: Intent to Sole Source aSTEM Detector
description: The United States Air Force, located at Wright-Patterson AFB, Ohio 45433-5344 publishes this notice of intent to award a sole source contract for informational purposes only. This proposed action is for the acquisition of an advanced Scanning Transmission Electron Microscopy (aSTEM) detector for the Air Force Institute of Technology (AFIT) located at Wright-Patterson AFB, Ohio 45433. The Government intends to solicit and negotiate with only one source under the authority of FAR 12.201(a), "Contracting officers may solicit from only one source if the contracting officer determines that the circumstances of the contract action deem only one source reasonably available", resulting in a firm-fixed-price contract. The Contracting Officer has determined that only one source is reasonably available: Carl Zeiss Microscopy, LLC. This proposed procurement will be a Sole Source under North American Industry Classification System code (NAICS) 334516 Analytical Laboratory Instrument Manufacturing. Business size standard is 1,000 employees. The proposed source is: Carl Zeiss Microscopy, LLC One North Broadway, White Plains, New York 10601-2310, United States This notice of intent is not a request for competitive quotations. However, all responsible sources may submit a capability statement, proposal, quotation, or exception to the intent to purchase on a sole source basis, which shall be considered by the Government if received within five (5) days of this notice. Information received will normally be considered solely for the purpose of determining whether to conduct a competitive procurement. In order to comply with FAR 5.207(c)(15), the reason for lack of competition is as follows: The proposed vendor, Carl Zeiss Microscopy, LLC, is the only known source able to satisfy the Government's requirement. While commercial STEM detection systems are manufactured globally, these alternative systems are physically, optically, and electronically incompatible with AFIT's existing host ZEISS Field Emission Scanning Electron Microscope (FE-SEM). Furthermore, direct outreach to Carl Zeiss Microscopy confirmed that they are the sole manufacturer and exclusive direct provider of the aSTEM detector, utilizing no authorized distributors or resellers. The Department of Defense (DoD) has determined the System for Award Management (SAM) to be the single DoD registration for contractors who conduct business or who are interested in conducting business with the DoD. Contractors must be registered in SAM prior to award for contracts issued after 29 May 2012. You may contact SAM at 866-606-8220. SAM website: www.sam.gov. The contact for this acquisition is Chris Hall and Linh Jameson. Any information should be e-mailed to christopherhall.113@us.af.mil and linh.jameson@us.af.mil no later than 4:00 pm Local (Wright-Patterson AFB) Time, 09 December 2026. Only inquiries/information received by this date will be considered. Be advised that all correspondence sent via e-mail shall contain a subject line that reads "aSTEM Detector". Note that e-mail filters at Wright-Patterson AFB are designed to filter e-mails without subject lines or with suspicious subject lines or contents (i.e., .exe, or .zip files). Therefore, if this subject line is not included, the e-mail may not get through the e-mail filters. Also, be advised that .zip or .exe files are not allowable attachments and may be deleted by the e-mail filters at Wright-Patterson AFB. If sending attachments with e-mail ensure only .PDF, .doc, or .xls documents are sent. The e-mail filter may delete any other form of attachments. title: Finland – Construction work – Ruovedentie 36 Säästökulman kiinteistön purku-urakka
description: Ruoveden kunta pyytää tarjousta omistamansa asuin- ja liikekiinteistö Säästökulman purku-urakasta tarjouspyyntöasiakirjojen mukaisesti. Purkukohde sijaitsee osoitteessa Ruovedentie 36, 34600 Ruovesi. Urakka sisältää rakennuksen purkamisen kokonaisuudessaan, purkujätteen asianmukaisen lajittelun, käsittelyn ja poiskuljetuksen sekä purkamisen jälkeiset maanrakennus-, täyttö- ja maisemointityöt. Kohteen sisätiloissa suoritetaan parhaillaan erillinen asbestipurku ja siihen liittyvä siivous laittoman haitta-ainepurun seurauksena. Suoritettavien töiden yhteydessä sisätiloista poistetaan tiedossa olevat asbesti- ja haitta-ainepitoiset materiaalit. Rakennuksen perustuksissa, julkisivuissa sekä muissa rakenteissa saattaa kuitenkin edelleen esiintyä haitta-aineita sisältäviä materiaaleja. Näiden materiaalien purkaminen, käsittely, pakkaaminen, kuljetus ja asianmukainen toimittaminen hyväksyttyyn vastaanottopaikkaan sisältyvät purku-urakkaan urakka-asiakirjoissa esitetyssä laajuudessa sekä voimassa olevien viranomaismääräysten mukaisesti. Tilaajalla on samanaikaisesti tarjouslaskennassa sisällöltään lähes vastaava purku-urakka. Kyseinen kohde sijaitsee noin 50 metrin etäisyydellä tästä purkukohteesta, ja kohteiden väliin jää yksi kiinteistö. Purkutyöt voidaan toteuttaa joko samanaikaisesti tai peräkkäin urakoitsijan tuotantosuunnittelun mukaisesti. Tarjoajaa pyydetään huomioimaan kyseinen mahdollinen synergiaetu tarjouslaskennassaan. Kohteet kilpailutetaan ja tilataan kuitenkin erillisinä toisistaan riippumattomina urakoina. Kumpaankin kohteeseen valitaan erikseen urakoitsija tarjouspyyntöasiakirjojen mukaisesti. Valintaperusteena on hinnaltaan halvin hyväksyt-tävä tarjous. Tarjouspyyntödokumentti, soveltuvuusvaatimukset, hankinnan kohde ja tarkemmat hankinnan tiedot tutustuttavissa latauslinkin takaa. Tilaajan järjestelmiin kirjattujen vikailmoitusten ja käytettävissä olevien tietojen perusteella arvioidaan, että sopimuksen perusteella voidaan tehdä vuosittain noin 150–250 yksittäistä huolto- tai vikakorjauskäyntiä tai työtilausta. Hankintasopimus syntyy vasta kirjallisen sopimuksen allekirjoittamisella, selonottoneuvottelujen jälkeen. EU-kynnysarvon ylittävässä hankinnassa sopimus voidaan tehdä aikaisintaan 14 vuorokauden kuluttua siitä, kun Tarjoaja on saanut tai hänen katsotaan saaneen päätöksen perusteluineen tiedoksi. Tarjoaja ei saa esittää esimerkiksi omissa tarjousasiakirjoissaan ehtoja, jotka vaikuttaisivat hankintasopimuksen sisältöön. Sopimuskauden tavoitealkamisajankohta on 1.3.2027.

SUMMARY OF SCOPE This project will replace the existing filtration system of the Dry Creek water treatment plant (WTP) serving the community of Warm Springs, OR. The existing filtration system has several deficiencies that are affecting the performance and increasing the difficulty of operating and maintaining the WTP. The replacement filtration system will consist of one or more containerized filtration units that utilize ceramic membrane filtration. The contractor shall furnish and install the filtration unit(s) into the existing WTP processes to provide safe drinking water for the community. The filtration system is a Greenleaf design (developed by Degremont). There are several deficiencies in the filtration system, including out of spec filter media, a lack of isolation and drain valves, and inadequate backwashing. Additionally, a recent camera inspection of the underdrains identified cracking along the length of one of the cells under drain piping. The filtration unit(s) will have to be compatible with and connected to several of the existing WTPs systems. These include the piping system (e.g. Raw Water, Washwater disposal, etc.), the electrical system, the control system, and the chemical treatment system. Additionally, the replacement filtration system will be subject to EPA Region 10 review. EPA�s requirements are described in the SOW, and coordination with the EPA during the review process will be required as part of the contract. The designer will need to be capable of advanced water treatment process design, as well as building design (e.g. architectural, structural, etc.). The performance of the replacement filtration system shall be able to meet the EPA Primary Drinking water standards. During the construction phase, capability requirements include the cooperation of the designer and builder, including project management and superintendence required of a typical general contractor, all of the applicable subcontractors for building, and site work, and in addition the full suite of engineering services needed. The contractor will be responsible for providing housing possibilities and per diem for their workers who are not local, and maintaining a constant presence on site. Performance requirements of the construction will be developed as part of the 100% technical specifications, and will be verified during the filtration system commissioning. The design shall be completed in accordance with the 2025 A/E Design Guide. The anticipated project magnitude is between $1,000,000 and $5,000,000. title: Gill MaxiMet all-in-one weather sensors for the NDBC, Stennis Space Center
description: The National Data Buoy Center (NDBC) requires 20 spare Gill Instruments MaxiMet all-in-one weather sensors for use with the SCOOP system. This is a brand name requirement due to the unique performance and compatibility of the MaxiMet sensors in the harsh marine environment. The Government intends to make an award to the responsive responsible quoter providing the lowest price in accordance with FAR 13.106-2(B)(3). This is a small business set-aside. Evaluation will be made on the basis of price and delivery schedule. Brand-name Justification: This procurement is for the brand name Gill Instruments MaxiMet all-in-one weather. During the initial development of the SCOOP system all of the commercially available all-in-one weather sensors were evaluated for use on the SCOOP system (see attached All-in-one Sensor Comparison). A very limited number of sensors met the NDBC technical requirements. The NDBC had previous experience with other sensors. Alternative sensors failed to meet performance standards due to issues such as water intrusion, high failure rates, sensor drift, lack of serial interface support, and insufficient survivability in harsh marine environments. Some models showed initial promise but did not meet key reliability thresholds for wind, pressure, and temperature measurements, or remain under extended evaluation. The selected sensor demonstrated the best overall performance, with acceptable data accuracy and significantly fewer deployment failures than others tested. The purpose is to identify potential sources possessing the requisite technical capability, manufacturing capacity, and industry technologies to manufacture and deliver up to 7,000 High-Gravity (High-G) Pressure Transducers (gauges) in support of various programs. The results of this market research will assist the Government in determining the appropriate acquisition strategy and procurement method (e.g., small business set-aside, full and open competition, or sole-source justification under FAR 6.302-1). All small business socioeconomic categories (8(a), HUBZone, SDVOSB, WOSB) will be considered. Telephone inquiries will not be accepted or acknowledged, and no individual feedback or evaluations will be provided regarding submissions. 2.0 DISCLAIMER: THIS SOURCES SOUGHT IS FOR INFORMATIONAL AND PLANNING PURPOSES ONLY. THIS IS NOT A REQUEST FOR PROPOSAL (RFP) AND SHALL NOT BE CONSTRUED AS A FORMAL SOLICITATION OR COMMITMENT BY THE GOVERNMENT. RESPONSES IN ANY FORM DO NOT CONSTITUTE OFFERS, AND THE GOVERNMENT IS UNDER NO OBLIGATION TO AWARD A CONTRACT ON THE BASIS OF THIS ANNOUNCEMENT. NO FUNDS ARE AVAILABLE TO COMPENSATE PARTICIPANTS FOR PREPARATION OR SUBMISSION OF INFORMATION REGARDING THIS ANNOUNCEMENT. ANY INFORMATION SUBMITTED IS ENTIRELY VOLUNTARY. RESPONSES WILL NOT BE RETURNED. NOT RESPONDING TO THIS NOTICE DOES NOT PRECLUDE PARTICIPATION IN ANY SUBSEQUENT FORMAL RFP, IF ISSUED. 3.0 PROGRAM BACKGROUND: The PMI Division requires high-reliability pressure transducers to support various testing within precision projectile development programs. The test projectiles feature dedicated telemetry circuitry engineered to interface with miniature, piezoresistive high-shock transducers. Previously, part numbers HKS-HP-375, HKS-11HP-375, HKS-37-375, and HPS-375 demonstrated qualification in meeting the extreme shock, high-pressure, and thermal environments encountered during live gun-firing conditions. The Government seeks to establish a five (5) year Firm-Fixed-Price (FFP) Indefinite Delivery / Indefinite Quantity (IDIQ) contract to fulfill ongoing and surge requirements across Army munitions testing activities. 4.0 REQUIRED CAPABILITIES: 4.1 The transducers must operate accurately across an operating pressure range spanning from 50 psi (0.01 kpsi) up to 100,000 psi (100 kpsi). 4.2 The transducers must survive and maintain measurement fidelity during and after exposure to severe gun-launch accelerations exceeding 2,000 Gs to 20,000+ Gs. 4.3 The transducers must conform to miniature physical envelope constraints, defined as approximately 0.25� to 1.0� in diameter and 1.0" in nominal body length. 4.4 The manufacturing capability must support the delivery of up to 7,000 total transducers over a 60-month ordering period, with typical delivery order fulfillment achieved within twenty (20) weeks After Receipt of Order (ARO). 4.5 Proposed items must be Non-Developmental Items (NDI) or Commercial-Off-The-Shelf (COTS) to the maximum extent practicable. Transducers must possess established qualification or demonstrate verifiable test data proving survivability and calibration fidelity during high-pressure, high-acceleration ballistics events. 4.6 The transducers must require zero (0) organizational-level field maintenance prior to installation, demonstrate stable long-term calibration retention during extended storage, and be delivered with individual Certificates of Conformance (CoC). 5.0 SPECIAL REQUIREMENTS & COMPLIANCE: 5.1 Security Classification: The resulting contract effort is UNCLASSIFIED. 5.2 Export Control Laws / ITAR: This procurement involves technical data subject to the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) and the Export Administration Regulations (EAR). 5.3 DFARS 252.225-7048, Export-Controlled Items, and DoD Directive 5230.25 will apply. 5.4. All respondents must possess an active, valid Joint Certification Program (JCP) certification or demonstrate eligibility to receive and handle controlled technical data under Title 22, U.S.C. App. 2401 et seq 5.5 Specialty Metals / Domestic Preferences: Compliance with the specialty metals restrictions of the Berry Amendment (10 U.S.C. 2533b / DFARS 252.225-7008 & 252.225-7009 is mandatory, unless an applicable statutory exception or class deviation applies. 6.0 ELIGIBILITY & CLASSIFICATION: Businesses of all sizes are encouraged to respond; however, each respondent must explicitly identify its socioeconomic status and small business classifications in its submittal. The following information must be provided: 6.1 NAICS Code: 334519 � Other Measuring and Controlling Device Manufacturing 6.2 Small Business Size Standard: 600 Employees (or 500 under historical tables) 6.3 Product Service Code (PSC): 6685 � Pressure, Temperature, and Humidity Measuring and Controlling Instruments 7.0 SUBMISSION DETAILS: Interested sources are requested to submit a Capabilities Statement package with the following: 7.1 Technical Capabilities: Please submit your firm�s capability to manufacture, test, calibrate, and deliver miniature High-G pressure transducers capable of meeting the following specifications and operational criteria: 7.1.1 Compatibility or form/fit/function parity with parts HKS-HP-375, HKS-11HP-375, HKS-37-375, and HPS-375. 7.1.2 Pressure Range Proof: Provide specific model numbers, product brochures, and technical data sheets verifying the operational pressure limits of the proposed sensors across the 50 psi to 100,000 psi range. 7.1.3 Environmental & Dynamic Tolerance Proof: Submit information demonstrating successful high-shock and high-acceleration survivability between 2,000 Gs and 20,000+ Gs. 7.1.4 Physical Dimensions & Form Factor Proof: Submit dimensional engineering drawings, mechanical interface diagrams, or physical specification sheets confirming compliance with the 0.25� to 1.0� diameter and 1.0" nominal body length envelope. 7.1.5 Production Capacity & Lead Time Proof: State the manufacturing facility's maximum monthly and annual production capacity and explicitly confirm the capability to meet the 20-week ARO delivery timeline for orders up to 7,000 total transducers. 7.1.6 Item Classification (COTS/NDI) Proof: Explicitly state whether the proposed transducers are current COTS/NDI products. If modifications are required to meet any specification, detail the precise developmental delta, modifications needed, and the projected qualification timeline. 7.1.7 Qualification & Verification Proof: Submit evidence of existing qualification or verifiable test data proving sensor survivability and calibration fidelity during high-pressure, high-acceleration ballistics events. 7.1.8 Maintenance, Calibration, & Certification Proof: Confirm that the units require zero organizational field maintenance, provide empirical data supporting long-term calibration stability/shelf-life during extended storage, and verify that Certificates of Conformance (CoC) will be provided with every delivered lot. 7.2. Relevant Past Performance: 7.2.1. Relevant Government or commercial contract references within the past three (3) years of similar scope and complexity (including contract number, agency/customer point of contact (phone number/email if possible), dollar value, and technical description). 7.3 Teaming / Subcontracting: If teaming or subcontracting is planned, identify the anticipated work share and administrative structure. 8.0 SUBMISSION INSTRUCTIONS: 8.1 Length & Format: No more than ten (10) pages (8.5 x 11 inch), standard 1-inch margins, minimum 10-point font. Documents must be submitted in searchable Adobe PDF or Microsoft Word format. 8.2 Corporate Overview: 8.2.1. Company name, facility address, and manufacturing plant

title: Bravo Dive Boat 65DS1101
description: AMENDMENT 0003 POSTED 11/26. AMENDMENT 0002 POSTED 11/21. AMENDMENT 0001 POSTED 11/19. The Regional Maintenance Center at Puget Sound Naval Shipyard & Intermediate Maintenance Facility (PSNS & IMF) intends to award a stand-alone Firm-Fixed-Price contract to accomplish the maintenance, repair, and preservation in support of one (1) 65 FT BRAVO DIVE BOAT 65DS1101. Work will be accomplished at the Contractor's facility. Geographical Area of consideration: To facilitate proper government oversight, the facility shall be located in the Puget Sound, WA region. For this procurement, the Puget Sound, WA region is defined as the West Coast of the continental US, starting from Olympia, WA and extending northward to Bellingham, WA. 65DS1101 Length: 69 FT 10 IN Width: 22 FT 0 IN Draft: 3 FT 6 IN Full Displacement: 55 L TONS Age: 13 YEARS Light Load: 8,000 lbs Hull Type: Aluminum Scope Overview: Coordinate with the Contracting Officer, via the Contracting Officer�s Representative (COR) to deliver the vessel to the Contractor�s facility from Puget Sound Naval Shipyard (PSNS) Bremerton, WA. Remove all fendering and sweep blast clean. Accomplish survey of hull to identify and repair corrosion, preserve the exterior above and below the waterline, including the crane. Apply nonskid to horizontal surfaces on the exterior and interior of the boat. Replace motor mounts. Remove, inspect and install shafting, rudders and propellers. HVAC repair. Maintain and repair watertight hatches and doors. Repair, modify and preserve push knee. Replace and modify corroded deck and bulkhead structure in the main cabin. Install remote fuel shut offs. Identify and repair corrosion beneath the transformers in the aft lazzarette, install a weather shield above the starboard transformer in the aft lazzarette. Replace hydraulic, and fuel hoses. Identify and repair corroded structure beneath the shower room drain. Remove windows, repair window heaters, and reinstall windows. Replace fire suppression system piping and recertify system. Repair damage to the port bow. Accomplish modification and repair of swim platform stairs. Restore preservation system on the console in the pilot house. Replace existing generators with supplied Kohler generators, Modify, repair and install fendering system. Modify and repair the monkey heater system. Remove, inspect, preserve and install rudders. Replace thru hull valves and flexible hoses. Replace false bulkheads in the shower room and head. Open, clean and inspect all tanks. Offerors are advised also that SAM representations and certifications can be completed electronically via the System for Award Management website at https://www.sam.gov. title: Germany – Architectural, engineering and planning services – Neugestaltung Innenstadt Brake - Nicht offener, einphasiger, freiraumplanerischer Wettbewerb mit verkehrsplanerischen Aspekten und Konzeptteil mit Teilnahmewettbewerb und nachg. Verhandlungsverfahren
description: Die Stadt Brake (Unterweser) beabsichtigt, ihre Innenstadt umfassend aufzuwerten und neu zu ordnen. Als Kreisstadt des Landkreises Wesermarsch liegt Brake am westlichen Ufer der Unterweser im nordwestlichen Niedersachsen, im Städteviereck Wilhelmshaven - Bremerhaven - Bremen - Oldenburg. Der Landkreis ist überwiegend ländlich geprägt und gilt als strukturschwach. Hintergrund der angestrebten Innenstadtumgestaltung ist ein erkennbarer Handlungs- und Steuerungsbedarf der im Kontext der Erstellung eines Integrierte Stadtentwicklungskonzept (ISEK) identifiziert wurde. Nach Einschätzung des ISEKs gelingt es der Innenstadt in jüngerer Zeit nicht mehr ausreichend, ihr Potenzial als Versorgungszentrum für die Region und ihre Bewohnenden zu entfalten. In der Folge erstellte die Stadt Brake (Unterweser) ein Integriertes Handlungskonzept - den sogenannten "Masterplan Innenstadt Brake (Unterweser) - und bewarb sich mit diesem Konzept zur Neuordnung der Innenstadt im Städtebauförderprogramm "Lebendige Zentren. Der Aufnahmebescheid ging im Dezember 2023 ein. Vor diesem Hintergrund soll der Stadterneuerungsprozess über einen freiraumplanerischen Wettbewerb mit verkehrlichen Aspekten und Konzeptteil vorangetrieben werden. Ziel ist es, die architektonische und freiraumplanerische Qualität ebenso wie die funktionale Leistungsfähigkeit der Innenstadt durch vergleichende Entwurfsansätze abzusichern. Dazu werden Planungsteams aus der Landschaftsarchitektur und Verkehrsplanung eingeladen einen Entwurf für die Entwicklung der Innenstadt zu erarbeiten. Teilnahmeberechtigt sind außerdem Stadtplaner in Zusammenarbeit mit Planungsteams aus der Landschaftsarchitektur und Verkehrsplanung. Angesichts der Bedeutung der Innenstadt als Entwicklungsimpuls für die Gesamtstadt wird ein ganzheitlicher, Lösungsansatz benötigt, der städtebauliche, freiraumplanerische und verkehrliche Anforderungen schlüssig zusammenführt. Darüber hinaus sind Themen der Nachhaltigkeit, der Klimafolgenanpassung und der ökologischen Aufwertung als Querschnittsthemen mitzudenken. Weiter sind Barrierefreiheit und Inklusion konsequent zu beachten. Neben der Entwurfserstellung für die zentrale Lage der Innenstadt (Fußgängerzone) werden im Wettbewerbsverfahren vorgegebenen Teilbereiche detaillierter betrachtet und übergeordnet beplant. Das im Wettbewerb überzeugendste Gesamtkonzept wird durch eine Fachjury prämiert. Gegenstand der Beauftragung ist neben der baulichen Neuordnung der innenstädtischen Fußgängerzone die Erarbeitung eines Gestaltungshandbuchs. Dieses soll eine einheitliche und funktionale Gestaltung der gesamten Innenstadt sowie angrenzender Räume ermöglichen und ist im ersten Schritt zu erstellen. Hierzu sollen unter anderem verbindliche Leitideen und Gestaltungsvorgaben zur Steigerung der Aufenthaltsqualität, zur Nutzungsvielfalt und zur Bildung von Begegnungsorten entwickelt werden. Das Gestaltungshandbuch soll konkrete, künftig einheitlich zu verwendende Gestaltungselemente und Materialien festlegen. Diese Vorgaben sind bei sämtlichen zukünftigen Planungen und Maßnahmen zu berücksichtigen. Das Verfahren erfolgt als nicht offener, einphasiger, freiraumplanerischer Wettbewerb mit verkehrlichen Aspekten und Konzeptteil vorgeschaltetem Teilnahmewettbewerb und nachgeschaltetem Verhandlungsverfahren gem. VgV. Im Rahmen des Teilnahmewettbewerbs werden 3 Planungsteams als Teilnehmende für den Wettbewerb ausgewählt. Zusätzlich werden 2 Planungsteams als Teilnehmende für das Verfahren gesetzt. Der Wettbewerbsausschuss der Architektenkammer Niedersachsen hat Kenntnis vom Inhalt dieser Auslobung erhalten und beratend mitgewirkt. Der Wettbewerb wurde unter der Nummer 212-32-26/14 registriert. Die Vergabestelle lässt sich in der operativen Umsetzung dieses Verfahrens durch das Büro D&K drost consult GmbH, Hamburg, unterstützen und beratend begleiten.

title: Germany – Architectural services for outdoor areas – Freianlagenplanung: Freie und Hansestadt Hamburg Altona A7-Deckel
description: Das Bezirksamt Hamburg-Altona plant das Projekt "Deckel Altona" im Rahmen des Ausbaus der Autobahn A7. Es umfasst dabei die Errichtung eines 2.230 Meter langen Lärmschutztunnels mit einer Überdeckung der Fahrbahn und die freiraumplanerische Gestaltung der darauf entstehenden Flächen. Hier wird die Autobahn im Abschnitt Altona von sechs auf acht Fahrstreifen erweitert und durch die Überdeckelung eine städtebauliche Verbindung zwischen zuvor getrennten Stadtteilen hergestellt. Das Tunnelbauwerk überspannt bei einer Stärke der Tunneldecke von 1,28 bis 1,75 m im Regelquerschnitt freitragend Breiten von 21 m, in Aufweitungsbereichen von bis zu ca. 30 m. Entsprechend gelten klare Vorgaben für die auf das Bauwerk maximal aufzubringenden ständigen Lasten sowie zusätzliche Nutzlasten. Auf einer Gesamtfläche von rund 214.000 m² sollen in etwa 119.000 m² Parkanlagen und 95.000 m² Kleingartenflächen realisiert werden. Davon befinden sich ca. 105.000 m² Fläche direkt über dem Tunnelbauwerk. Als Begleitmaßnahme zum Tunnelbauwerk erfolgt ein großer Teil des Bodenauftrags durch eine gesonderte Fachplanung. Die Übergabe der Flächen - nach der Andeckung Unter- und Oberboden, der Erstellung der Wegeaufbauten bis OK ungebundene Tragschicht sowie die Herstellung von Entwässerungsleitungen erforderliche Entwässerungseinrichtungen bis 1,0 m vor der Einrichtung - durch die Fachplanung Boden definiert die Leistungsgrenze, auf welcher die nachfolgenden Gewerke aufbauen. Dabei ist oberhalb der Tunneldecke, sowie in den Randbereichen der Tunneldecke, aus statischen Gründen max. 1,20 Meter möglich.

title: Denmark – Electrical installation work – Rammeaftale for Elektronisk og Mekanisk Sikring
description: Etablissement- og Terrænkommandoen (herefter benævnt "ETK") ønsker at indgå flere Delaftaler om Elektronisk og Mekanisk Sikring med henblik på sikring af ETK bygninger og anlæg. I det følgende benævnes alle fem (5) Delaftaler som Rammeaftalen. Rammeaftalen omfatter blandt andet levering, installation, programmering, idriftsættelse, integration, service, vedligeholdelse, eftersyn, fejlafhjælpning, reparation, udskiftning, support, etablering af fiberinfrastruktur, dokumentation samt øvrige ydelser med tilknytning til de omfattede anlæg og produkter. Ydelserne leveres i entreprise og omfatter blandt andet Opgaver (under DKK 100.000), Planlagte og periodiske Eftersyn samt akut beredskab til håndtering af opståede fejl og skader i form af Stop skaden opgaver. Projekter (på eller over DKK 100.000) i form af blandt andet planlagt etablering af nye anlæg, udvidelser, ombygninger m.v. Ydermere inkluderer Rammeaftalen håndtering af Kampkraftopbyggende opgaver. Rammeaftalen er opdelt i Delaftaler (herefter under ét benævnt ”Delaftale”) fordelt på fem (5) geografiske områder med fire (4) Entreprenører pr. Region: • Delaftale 1 Nordjylland • Delaftale 2 Midtjylland • Delaftale 3 Syddanmark • Delaftale 4 Sjælland • Delaftale 5 Hovedstaden og Bornholm De fire (4) Entreprenører bliver på hver Delaftale rangeret som henholdsvis bedst/næstbedst/tredjebedst/fjerdebedst Entreprenør, på baggrund af vurderingen ved tildeling af Rammeaftalen i udbudsforretningen. Bedst rangerede Entreprenør på Delaftalen vil få tildelt alle Arbejder med en værdi under DKK 100.000 samt Stop skaden og Eftersyn. Alle Projekter med en værdi på eller over DKK 100.000 vil blive tildelt efter miniudbud blandt Entreprenørerne. Ved miniudbud på Delaftalen, inviteres alle Entreprenører til at afgive tilbud. ETK kan uanset opgavens værdi, under hensyntagen til den konkrete opgaves karakter, omfang og tidsmæssige rammer tildele Kampkraftopbyggende opgaver til den Entreprenør, som ETK vurderer bedst kan varetage den Kampkraftopbyggende opgave. Rammeaftalen omfatter ydelser, der naturligt henhører under Elektronisk og Mekanisk sikring. Rammeaftalen omfatter ikke perimeterhegn. Ydelser inkluderer blandt andet følgende: Elektronisk Sikring • Automatisk indbrudsalarmanlæg (AIA) • Elektronisk adgangskontrolanlæg (ADK) • TV-overvågningsanlæg (TVO) • Porttelefoni • Etablering af fiberinfrastruktur Mekanisk Sikring • Sikringsdøre og sikringspartier i relevante RC-klasser • Gitterdøre og gitterpartier • Glaspartier med og uden RC-klasser • Forstærkning af vægge, gulve og lofter • Etablering og forstærkning af konstruktioner i henhold til specificeret sikringsniveau • Vægmoduler og andre præfabrikerede sikringskonstruktioner i relevante RC-klasser • Rullegitre og rullejalousier • Gitre, bure, løvebure og tilsvarende afskærmninger • Mekaniske låsekasser, beslag og øvrige mekaniske sikringskomponenter • Ikke klassificeret låse, cylindre og nøglesystemer • Tilpasning og reetablering af eksisterende bygningsdele i forbindelse med etablering af mekanisk sikring • Demontering og bortskaffelse af eksisterende mekaniske sikringsprodukter, hvor dette er omfattet af den konkrete opgave Listen er ikke udtømmende. Der kan således i aftaleperioden opstå behov for yderligere ydelser, som naturligt henhører under de ovenfor beskrevne ydelser og deres anvendelsesområde. Rammeaftalen omfatter ikke bygningsarbejder (murer, tømrer, maler osv.) som selvstændige ydelser. Dog skal Entreprenøren ved Arbejder, hvor bygningsarbejder indgår som en nødvendig del, inkludere og koordinere Underleverandører. I sådanne tilfælde vil Entreprenøren have det fulde ansvar for styring, koordinering og kvalitetssikring af samtlige ydelser, uanset om de udføres af Entreprenøren selv eller af dennes underleverandører. Entreprenøren skal således ved tilbudsafgivelsen indregne, at Entreprenøren hæfter fuldt ud over for ETK for udførelsen af disse byggefaglige ydelser. Rammeaftalens samlede maksimumværdi udgør DKK 5.625.000.000. Se en nærmere redegørelse herom i udbudsbetingelsernes afsnit 4.

title: MVE CryoCart SAVAHCS Research Service
description: The Department of Veterans Affairs (VA), Southern Arizona VA Health Care System (SAVAHCS), Research Service, has a requirement for the acquisition and delivery of an MVE CryoCart, manufacturer item number 14448703, on a brand-name-only basis. The equipment is required to support ongoing laboratory research operations and facilitate the safe and efficient handling and transportation of cryogenically stored biological materials. In accordance with FAR 13.106-1(b)(1), the Government has determined that the specified brand-name product is necessary to meet its minimum requirements. Substitution with an alternative product could result in compatibility issues with existing equipment and established laboratory procedures, operational inefficiencies, and increased risk to the integrity of cryogenically stored research materials. Therefore, alternative brands or substitute products will not be considered. The Government previously issued a Request for Information (RFI), Notice ID 36C26227Q0123, to assess industry capabilities, product availability, and potential sources of supply. Based on the results of market research, this requirement is being solicited as a total small business set-aside utilizing the commercial acquisition and simplified acquisition procedures under FAR Parts 12 and 13. The contractor shall furnish and deliver a complete product in accordance with the solicitation requirements. The quoted firm-fixed price shall include all costs associated with furnishing and delivering the product, including packaging, handling, freight, shipping, delivery, manufacturer�s documentation, and standard warranty support. All eligible small business concerns capable of furnishing the specified product are encouraged to submit a quotation. Interested vendors shall review the solicitation and associated attachments for complete technical requirements, delivery requirements, applicable terms and conditions, evaluation criteria, and quotation submission instructions. Responses to the previously issued RFI do not constitute quotations under this RFQ
